## Change

Describe the problem, result and scope. For documentation-only work, confirm that executable files are unchanged.

## Validation

- [ ] Checks and audit pass, or limitations are explained.
- [ ] Generated assets match their sources.
- [ ] Test environment and API contracts are preserved.
- [ ] No private or financial data is included.
- [ ] Manual Google steps, if any, are documented.

Pages publication does not install Apps Script or activate production.
